criteria.reason: Passing test: AC 1, iteration 1 exercises the whole open set; after Debug only the representatives of the addressed causes.
criteria.statement: After a Debug pass, the next iteration's Exercise pass is dispatched only for the representative criterion of each cause that Debug pass addressed; no other open build-defect criterion appears in that iteration's Exercise dispatch

criteria.reason: Passing tests: AC 4, a carried criterion keeps its last verdict; a cause whose representative is not re-checked is handed to the Judge as a literal to keep.
criteria.statement: In an iteration after a Debug pass, an open criterion that was not dispatched to Exercise is not re-judged: it reaches the Judge as "open, not re-checked this iteration" and its status and cause in verification-state.json are unchanged from the previous iteration

criteria.reason: Passing test: re-captures an evidence gap the Judge ruled but left out of debugGaps, so a targeted iteration does not strand it.
criteria.statement: An evidence-gap re-capture that F-1 already schedules is still dispatched in an iteration after a Debug pass, alongside the addressed causes' representatives

criteria.reason: Passing test: AC 1, every iteration before the first Debug pass exercises the whole open set.
criteria.statement: The first iteration of every invocation (a fresh run, a resume, a /verify-build fix round) exercises the whole open set; targeting applies only after a Debug pass within the same invocation

criteria.reason: Passing tests: the Judge schema accepts causeKey and awaiting; Debug gets one gap per cause, with its representative and members.
criteria.statement: The Judge returns a cause key on every build-defect criterion it rules, and criteria the Judge rules to share a root cause carry the same key and are grouped by the workflow into one cause

criteria.reason: Passing test: AC 2, a missing or malformed causeKey makes the criterion its own cause, criterion:<id>, and is logged.
criteria.statement: A build-defect criterion returned by the Judge with a missing or malformed cause key becomes its own cause, keyed criterion:<id>, and the substitution is logged

criteria.reason: Passing state-sync and Judge-prompt tests (AC 4, AC 5). The live fixture state file shows each cause with its key, representative and members, and causeKey on each member.
criteria.statement: verification-state.json records every cause with its key, its members and its representative (a top-level causes key), and each build-defect criterion's entry carries its causeKey

criteria.reason: Passing test: a causes input renders a Causes section; an input without it is byte-identical.
criteria.statement: verification-report.md shows a Causes section listing each cause's key, members and representative

criteria.reason: Passing AC 3 representative tests: first non-check-derived member; first member when all are check-derived; stable across iterations.
criteria.statement: Each cause's representative is chosen deterministically: the first member in success-definition order that is not check-derived, or, if every member is check-derived, the first member; the choice is the same on every iteration for the same membership

criteria.reason: Passing tests: the representative moves off a check-derived member once a non-check-derived member exists, and is the first member when all are check-derived. Combined with the representative-only targeting test (AC 1).
criteria.statement: A check-derived criterion (derivation: check:<skill>) is exercised in an iteration after a Debug pass only when it is its cause's representative, which happens only when every member of its cause is check-derived

criteria.reason: Passing test: dispatches ONE app-debugger per remediate iteration with one gap per cause (representative, members, union of files).
criteria.statement: Debug receives one gap per open cause, carrying the representative's evidence plus the members' functional statements, rather than one gap per criterion

criteria.reason: Passing test: a 20-member cause is re-checked through its representative.
criteria.statement: A cause with many members (for example 20 criteria) is re-checked in the inner loop through exactly one representative: in an iteration after Debug addressed it, exactly one of its members is dispatched to Exercise

criteria.reason: Passing test: once the representative is met the cause closes, and its 19 other members await the regression pass, outside every later inner-loop Exercise prompt.
criteria.statement: When a cause's representative is judged met, the cause closes and its other members are marked awaiting: "regression"; they are not dispatched to Exercise or re-judged in any later inner-loop iteration

criteria.reason: Passing decideNext test: awaiting ids neither hold the run open nor count as closed.
criteria.statement: Members awaiting the regression pass are excluded from the gaps the next-step decision counts, so a closed cause's other members do not hold the loop open to the iteration cap

criteria.reason: Passing test: AC 2, a representative ruled not_met under a new valid key closes its old cause and joins the new one.
criteria.statement: When a representative is judged failing under a different (validated) cause key, its old cause closes, that cause's other members are marked awaiting the regression pass, and the representative becomes a member of the new cause

criteria.reason: Passing D15 confirmation-pass tests: one Exercise and one Judge over only the awaiting members, with no Debug; no pass at exit-unbuilt or exit-setup-failure.
criteria.statement: When the loop reaches an exit other than exit-unbuilt or exit-setup-failure and members are awaiting the regression pass, the workflow runs exactly one Exercise and Judge pass over only those members, outside the iteration cap, with no Debug after it; criteria already met are not re-checked in it

criteria.reason: Passing test: the confirmation pass sets cap = iteration, and a member still failing makes a satisfied exit non-satisfied.
criteria.statement: An awaiting member judged still failing in the exit confirmation pass keeps the run from ending satisfied, and that pass's next-step decision is made with the cap set to the current iteration so it can never return remediate

criteria.reason: Passing test: re-captures only the causes Debug addressed; an unaddressed or unlisted cause is left out and logged.
criteria.statement: Members of a cause the last Debug pass did not address stay open and untouched: neither the representative nor any other member is dispatched to Exercise or re-judged in the next iteration, and each keeps its last verdict

criteria.reason: Passing test: a pre-check that fails, or has no exit code, keeps its cause out of the next Exercise set.
criteria.statement: Debug may return a pre-check (command, exitCode) per cause; a failing pre-check (non-zero exit code) marks the cause not addressed, so its representative is not re-captured that iteration

criteria.reason: Passing tests: a passing pre-check is only a hint to that slice, and the hint does not outlive its iteration.
criteria.statement: A passing pre-check never settles a criterion met: the representative is still re-captured and judged, the pre-check reaches Exercise only as a hint, and the Judge's prompt never contains it

criteria.reason: Passing tests: a closed cause with no closed criterion remediates and is returned as closedCauses; with neither a criterion nor a cause closed, the run stalls.
criteria.statement: The next-step decision counts closed causes as well as closed criteria: it reports the causes closed since the previous iteration, and it returns stalled only when neither a criterion nor a cause closed

criteria.reason: Passing test: D14 turns exit-stalled into remediate below the cap when a cause closed, and leaves it alone otherwise.
criteria.statement: When the Judge returns exit-stalled but the script's own cause map shows a cause closed that iteration, the script overrides the stall and the loop continues

criteria.reason: Passing tests: at the cap the replacement is exit-stuck, and dispatching stops once args.cap is reached.
criteria.statement: The inner loop stays bounded by the existing iteration cap: no targeted iteration runs beyond it, and the exit confirmation pass adds no inner-loop round

criteria.reason: The fixture run (two causes over six criteria; norm-no-trim-collapse fixed, fold-skips-first-element not) wrote a verification-state.json whose iteration-2 exercised entry is exactly ["FS-1"], the fixed cause's representative, and which carries the full exercised history and a causes record. A resume comparison driving verify-functional.js with three snapshots (iteration+criteria+gapsClosed only, plus exercised and causes, the whole state file) gave identical dispatches, Exercise prompts and results. The workflow reads resume.exercised only to seed its audit history (by design, implement-trd Step 8.2 D18) and never reads causes; neither steers the loop. The comparison is a scratch script, not a committed jest test.
